The cover's 'Last Report' column is entirely EMPTY (this is the filer's first report of the cycle, the 7-days-before-convention box), so this-report and cumulative coincide and the verdict is exact rather than period-exact.

itemized.notes: 2026-cycle filing, four pages: p1 = the county's new cover (TYPED, the '7 days before the candidates' convention' box marked X, signed 4-2-2026), p2 = Form A, p3 = Form B sheet 1 (all 11 entries), p4 = Form B sheet 2 (six empty printed rows plus the grand total alone). All three schedule pages are TRUE LANDSCAPE carrying /Rotate 270 - with Katrina Gibson's filing (/Rotate 90) these are the only rotated pages in this chunk, and they are the reason the shared make_snippet crop tool could not be used for verification here. FILER CORRECTION HONORED ON THE COVER: the Ending Balance cells were typed 1,995.76, then struck through and replaced with a handwritten slashed-zero initialled 'MT'; the corrected value (0) governs and the struck 1,995.76 is recorded, per the handwritten-correction rule. The cover's 'Last Report' column is entirely blank - this is the filer's first report of the cycle - which is why both sides reconcile as exact rather than period-exact. THE CAMPAIGN IS ENTIRELY SELF-FUNDED AND PASS-THROUGH: every one of the six Form A rows is a contribution from the candidate himself, and each matches a same-dated Form B payment to the cent (931.39 filing fee, 13.19 / 12.95 GoDaddy, 248.88 = 83.88 + 165.00 on 3-24, 339.99 signs, 449.36 = 139.43 + 134.29 + 15.01 + 10.63 + 150.00 on 4-1) - contributions and expenditures both total 1,995.76 and the balance is zero. NO TRANSACTION DATE ON EITHER SCHEDULE CARRIES A YEAR (the filer wrote 1-7, 3-17, 3-19, 3-24, 3-31, 4-1); every one is kept verbatim, flagged, and NO year was inferred from the report date. The county REDACTED the candidate's street address and city/zip on the cover AND the entire Address column of Form A, so all six donor city/state values are honestly blank as county-redacted. No in-kind item is labelled anywhere. Neither schedule prints a per-page subtotal.
